detail:
Full summary: Wave 1 T2: backend + version surfacing shipped — StoreSet carries reason + legacy_unread; empty-sqlite-beside-legacy now warns loudly at boot (auto AND explicit paths) and as the FIRST twining_status warning; status response gains server_version/backend/backend_reason; description declares provisional_decisions the canonical ratify count.
Decisions: Chose an optional ServerIdentity 9th parameter on registerLifecycleTools with spread-if-present response fields over always-emitting fields with placeholder values — keeps the dashboard/test call sites compiling unchanged while production (server.ts) always supplies full identity; a placeholder 'unknown' version would recreate the exact reads-as-answer failure the audit documents.; Chose the runtime empty-db-beside-legacy check at the factory seam (sync COUNT on the decisions table after ingest) over a resolver-time check — it covers the explicit backend:sqlite path the resolver never sees and the valid-but-empty-db residue the S0 header guard deliberately does not catch; post-migrate repos stay quiet because their table is populated.
